newsitem.title: USA: Kansas feedlot cattle market thin at $70 - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Kansas feedlot cattle market thin at $70 - USDA.

text.p: Trade was slow, with no slaughter steer sales confirmed; few slaughter heifers steady, USDA said. Inquiry moderate, demand rather light.
Sales confirmed on 400 slaughter heifers Wednesday. For the week to date 43,500 head confirmed including 6,900 head or about 16 percent previously contracted or formulated cattle.
Sales FOB feedlot net weights after 4 percent shrink.
Slaughter heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1100-1150 lbs 70.00.
